ambient_extra/01_harbor_glass.concept: Large slowly rearranging stained-glass cells, hairline seams, and close Jewelry refractions.
ambient_extra/01_harbor_glass.design_intent: Hold the ship inside five immense stained-glass panes whose Voronoi borders migrate almost imperceptibly, with broad colored material on the Hull, a crisp seam drawing on the Silhouette, and only rare optical catches in Jewelry.
ambient_extra/01_harbor_glass.why_exists: It supplies a finite architectural glass look for ambient use: large cells and lead seams, not water, caustics, noise, or a repeating wave lattice.
ambient_extra/01_harbor_glass.visual_goal_titanic: From the playa the vessel should read as a continuously visible teal-and-gold glass icon; nearer viewers should discover pane identity, refraction, dark lead, and small jewel catches without losing the ship outline.
ambient_extra/01_harbor_glass.unique_topology: A fixed five-site 3D nearest/second-nearest Voronoi field; the literal d2-d1 gap creates lead seams while per-cell palette positions create five broad panes.
ambient_extra/01_harbor_glass.distance_silhouette: Silhouette strands invert the normal pane treatment into a bright, crisp seam perimeter over a persistent lit floor, so the outline stays complete even when Hull seams are dark.
ambient_extra/01_harbor_glass.close_detail: Lens falloff, near-lead refraction, five ordered palette positions, sparse golden-angle Vintage gem cuts, and catchlights occupying under 8% of their analytic cycle.
ambient_extra/01_harbor_glass.motion_grammar: Five independently clocked sites drift on golden-angle placements at irrationally related rates; the geometry rearranges continuously rather than scrolling, pulsing, or visibly looping.
ambient_extra/01_harbor_glass.xyz_use: World X/Y/Z all participate in the five 3D distance checks and in each site's migration. Identity computes signIndex = index % 74 and remaps that folded address into one complete 10x8/74-pixel local surface; both physical 40+34 signs therefore use identical local coordinates.
